summary: Returned semantic_judgments for the cover (封面) unit. Each source entry maps to ordered parts covering the cover layout's fixed labels, fill slots (thesis.title.zh, thesis.title.en, author.name.zh, author.student_id, author.cohort_class, advisor.name.zh, advisor.title, author.department, submission.date), and style-only format hints. The first source entry (附件1 封面基本格式) is judged as a pre-cover style/obligation preamble that does not belong to the visible cover layout; it must be carried as style_only, not as cover content. No new fields needed; vocabulary covers every fill slot. No open questions.

parts.text: 附件1 封面基本格式：单倍行距；上下页边距均为2.54厘米，左右页边距均为2.6厘米；除基本信息的5行内容外，其余内容均居中。“□” 表示占1个字宽（即2个字符）的空格。所做的为论文,则标题中设计不要；所做的为设计,则标题中论文不要。

The 学生姓名 label and the colon are fixed labels; the leading □□□□□□ are layout spacing and stay with the label. The parenthetical "(三号黑体加粗)" is a style hint for the label. The placeholder ××× (or ×□×) is the author name value position, bound to author.name.zh. The trailing "(三号楷体加粗)" is a style hint for the author name value (三号楷体加粗).
"□□□□□□学□□号：" is the fixed label including its leading spacing; the placeholder "20××××××××××" is the student ID fill slot. Bound to author.student_id (allowed_part_roles includes fill_slot).

"年级专业及班级：" is a fixed label; the school template merges grade, major and class into a single composite value, so the placeholder "20××级×××（×）班" is the composite cohort/major/class fill slot. Bound to author.cohort_class (meaning explicitly states the school template merges grade, major and class into one fill value).

The label "指导老师及职称：" is fixed; the template shows name and title as separate positionable parts (××× then a space then 教授). advisor.name.zh covers the name value; advisor.title (optional, allowed_part_roles includes fill_slot) covers the title "教授" placeholder. The single □ between them is layout spacing that belongs with the label area.

"□□□□□□学□□院：" is the fixed label including its leading spacing. "××××学院" is the department fill slot; the trailing note "(学院名用全称)" is a style/instruction hint requiring the full department name. Bound to author.department (allowed_part_roles includes fill_slot).
